title: Leakage and the reproducibility crisis in machine-learning-based science
mechanism: A taxonomy of 8 leakage types, plus model info sheets that argue train/test independence.
adaptation: Leakage audit for EL: the same module across splits, CFVS train twins, BMRK = ELPV cells, the leaky UCF-EL split, and pool images from test modules (SSL leakage). Publish a model info sheet with each split.
min_experiment: Compare house scores on test cells with vs without a same-module or twin cell in train. E: CFVS without a twin scores 0.397 crack IoU vs 0.474 overall. Decision: if the gap is > 0.03, twins must sit inside one fold.
prior_overlap: none as an audit; the twin effect has been observed but not formalised.
evidence: R: survey of leakage across 294 papers in 17 fields; proposes model info sheets.
